hints.title: Jump Over Painted Intervals
hints.text: Maintain a jump pointer array where each position points to the next unpainted position after it.

hints.title: Path Compression
hints.text: When traversing from start to end, compress visited positions using Disjoint Set Union find logic to leap across painted regions in O(1).

hints.title: Record New Area
hints.text: Count each newly painted unit segment and update jump pointers immediately to point to the next unpainted segment.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iteratively marking boolean cells takes O(N * max_coord) which is redundant on overlapping days.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Path compression DSU visits each segment at most once in O((N + M) alpha(M)) time and O(M) space where M <= 50,000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrate line sweep with jump pointers or interval merging.
